description: local>kanso-labs/.github:renovate-config is the organization's shared preset, listed last because a later preset wins a conflict with an earlier one. config:best-practices is not extended, because its helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests contradicts the convention that actions are pinned to exact release tags, and neither is security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm, because no kanso-labs repository waits out a release age.

packageRules.description: react and react-dom release together and must match, and their types follow them.
react-router and its build tooling release together at one version, and a mismatched pair fails the build.
